name: Chester Ransom

events.title: Built a sawmill
events.place: Harvey's Creek, Jackson Twp., Luzerne Co., PA
events.description: Replaced his father's 1815 mill. The 'old mill property of Chester Ransom' on Harvey's Creek (18-ft fall) was bought in 1890 by Mr. Frisbie, who rebuilt it and added a cider mill.

bioAdditions: Munsell (1880) and Bradsby (1893) both say that George P. Ransom's sawmill of 1815 wore out and that 'his son Chester' built a new one in 1840 (S1, S2). Bradsby's biography of a Mr. Frisbie says that in 1890 Frisbie bought 'the old mill property of Chester Ransom' on Harvey's Creek, which had a fall of eighteen feet, renovated it and added a cider mill (S1).

confidenceRecommendation.justification: Two county histories name him as George P. Ransom's son.

sources.citation: H. C. Bradsby, History of Luzerne County (1893), p.589 and Frisbie biography (Jackson Twp.)
sources.supports: son of George P. Ransom; mill 1840; mill property sold 1890

sources.citation: W. W. Munsell, History of Luzerne, Lackawanna and Wyoming Counties (1880), Jackson Twp.
sources.supports: son Chester erected the present mill in 1840
